sales_count.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM orders

sales_customers.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM customers

sales_amount.sql: SELECT sum(total_amount) AS total FROM orders

sales_status.sql: SELECT status, count(*) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY status

sales_region.sql: SELECT region, count(*) AS total FROM customers GROUP BY region

sales_empty.sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_id='NOT-EXIST'

product_count.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM products

product_active.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM products WHERE is_active=1

product_price.sql: SELECT max(price) AS total FROM products

product_category.sql: SELECT category, count(*) AS total FROM products GROUP BY category

inventory_count.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM inventory

inventory_quantity.sql: SELECT sum(quantity) AS total FROM inventory

inventory_warehouses.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM warehouses

inventory_low.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM inventory WHERE quantity < reorder_level

hr_count.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM employees

hr_active.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM employees WHERE IsActive=1

hr_salary.sql: SELECT avg(Salary) AS total FROM employees

hr_departments.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM departments

finance_accounts.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM accounts

finance_transactions.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM transactions

finance_alerts.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM fraud_alerts

finance_null.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM accounts WHERE credit_limit IS NULL

hotel_count.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM dim_hotel

hotel_cancelled.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM fact_reservations WHERE IsCancelled=1
